question: Which bandwidth options did the RareCloud Residential VPS offer at order time, and do they match the Do It Yourself VPS options?
why: unverified: behind a sign-up. The Residential VPS has no entry in the public product catalog (Product not found), its landing page redirects, its archived landing pages show no bandwidth figure (pricing loaded client-side), and the console deploy flow requires a sign-in. The public catalog lists Do It Yourself VPS bandwidth options from 4TB to 20TB while the Linux VPS page states 1 to 20 TB, so the DIY range is itself stated two ways. The product is out of stock, so an account could not order it to read the options.
